answer: Guarantor admission: a newcomer needs a guarantor staking 200 units for 15 epochs. Forge and the newcomer loses all, the guarantor 50% plus its rights for 10 epochs. Each backs at most 2 per epoch, so 1,000 clones need 500 guarantors risking 100,000 units. At 30% caught, joint loss is 45,000 units; honesty costs a 6-epoch wait. A mesa stands on guarantors, not paper; one pigment across 1,000 orchard saplings gets flagged.
